proposal.title: Ululthra: a timestamping service with public logs
proposal.summary: Ululthra builds a timestamping service with public logs for archivists and researchers.

sections.heading: Problem
sections.text: Documents cannot prove when they existed without a trusted third party. Archivists and researchers depend on trusted timestamping every day, yet the tools they have are hard to audit and slow to update.

sections.heading: Relevance to the Open Internet Stack
sections.text: Trusted timestamping is part of the Open Internet Stack. An open implementation lets anyone inspect, reuse and improve it without asking a vendor for permission.

sections.heading: Team and experience
sections.text: We maintain http://forge.test/ululthra/ululthra, which 109 public projects depend on. Our team has worked on trusted timestamping for 3 years.

sections.heading: Deliverables and licence
sections.text: All code will be released under the EUPL-1.2 licence in http://forge.test/ululthra/ululthra. Documentation will be published under CC BY 4.0.

sections.heading: Milestones
sections.text: The work runs over 8 months in 3 milestones. Design and threat model ends in month 3. Core implementation ends in month 6. Testing and fuzzing ends in month 8.

sections.heading: Budget justification
sections.text: The plan asks for 42050.00 EUR for 78 days of work over 3 tasks. Day rates range from 500.00 EUR to 550.00 EUR.

proposal.narrative:
Problem
Documents cannot prove when they existed without a trusted third party. Archivists and researchers depend on trusted timestamping every day, yet the tools they have are hard to audit and slow to update.

Relevance to the Open Internet Stack
Trusted timestamping is part of the Open Internet Stack. An open implementation lets anyone inspect, reuse and improve it without asking a vendor for permission.

Team and experience
We maintain http://forge.test/ululthra/ululthra, which 109 public projects depend on. Our team has worked on trusted timestamping for 3 years.

Deliverables and licence
All code will be released under the EUPL-1.2 licence in http://forge.test/ululthra/ululthra. Documentation will be published under CC BY 4.0.

Milestones
The work runs over 8 months in 3 milestones. Design and threat model ends in month 3. Core implementation ends in month 6. Testing and fuzzing ends in month 8.

Budget justification
The plan asks for 42050.00 EUR for 78 days of work over 3 tasks. Day rates range from 500.00 EUR to 550.00 EUR.
